list.name: usb_webcam
list.what: Adafruit Ultra Tiny USB Webcam (ada-5733) adapter cable: over the camera holder inside the face, out of the cradle's left (display) opening, down the left side with the display wires, left shoulder clip, turret, spine hole, along the rear of storey 2, down into the up-angle USB-A adapter on the Pi's rear USB stack
list.assumed: cable length NOT published by Adafruit: about 43 cm (40-46) measured off Adafruit's photo 5733-04; measure it before routing
list.part: Integrated captive USB-A cable on ada-5733 (2.1 mm OD)

list.name: uart_display
list.what: Display jumpers: from the joint beside the left shoulder clip down the left side, turret, spine hole, onto Pi pins 17-24 (21 free)
list.assumed: the Waveshare cable's 20 cm is the wiki's figure; jumper and cable outer diameters are typical (8 wires ~1.0 mm, bundle ~3.2 mm), NOT measured

list.name: usb_opencr_pi
list.what: USB: OpenCR micro-USB (right edge, under the Pi's USB end) to the Pi's front USB stack, lower port
list.part: USB 2.0 cable, 90-deg micro-B (cable UP) to 90-deg USB-A (cable to the robot's FRONT), the shortest sold (10-15 cm); the spare length lies as a loop in the right-front bay

list.name: pi_power
list.what: 5 V from the OpenCR (max 4 A) up the left wall, over the deck, down onto the Pi's GPIO 5 V pins (bypasses the Pi's input fuse)

list.part: 2-wire lead to make (22 AWG): Molex 5264-02 housing (mates the OpenCR's 5267-02A 5 V header) to a 1 x 3 2.54 mm crimp housing on Pi pins 2-4-6 (5 V, 5 V, GND)

notes: Revision intent: mech_M11c_open's printed parts, with every screw and every cable drawn where and as it really goes: the two boards' USB, the camera and display cables plugged at both ends, the display's joint, all screws as they look.
Inactive axes: P1.B (hypothesis ID 1) and P4.A (hypothesis ID 8) drive nothing and must not be commanded. With torque OFF they are free to spin but carry no load in this topology.
Joint sign: positive = direction of an increasing DYNAMIXEL position (CCW seen facing the horn, per e-Manual convention) - NOT verified on hardware.
The STEP does not model the output shaft; horn/idler meshes are excluded from collision proxies.
Electronics and camera are ENVELOPES with PRELIMINARY (UNMEASURED) sizes and assumed masses.
Printed-part masses assume PLA 1.24 g/cc at the stated fill (ASSUMPTION until weighed).
